title: Deceptive pictures.
text: Deceptive pictures.. I would love to give the pillow 5 stars but, I fell for the picture too and NOWHERE in the description or elsewhere could I find where it said how many pillows were included. I assumed for the price that there would be 2. Now I have 2 guests and one pillow. My fault, I usually read reviews. I would have known had I read them since the company failed to disclose this info. Good pillow though.
